title: Crash on Highway 359 at Cuatro Vientos; police on scene, victim's condition unknown
excerpt: A car accident was reported around 11:40 p.m. Monday on Highway 359 at Cuatro Vientos in Laredo. Police were on the scene and at least one victim was reported; the victim's condition was not immediately known.
content:
A car accident was reported around 11:40 p.m. Monday on Highway 359 at Cuatro Vientos in Laredo.

Nighttime dashcam video from the scene shows several police vehicles with flashing lights stopped in the road at the intersection as the driver approaches. The person recording reacts in shock and asks for prayers for the victim.

At least one victim was reported at the scene. The victim's condition was not immediately known, and no official statement about the crash had been released as of Tuesday morning.

Source: Eyewitness video, Threads, Nov. 24, 2026.
